title: Nostalgic Smoky Silk Soy Milk Stew
description: A Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring smoky flavors and a silky texture made with plant-based soy milk.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add smoked paprika and tomato paste, stirring for about 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.
Stir in minced garlic and finely chopped onions. Cook for another 3-4 minutes or until softened.
Include diced bell peppers and sliced zucchini into the pot, mixing well with the onion mixture.
Pour in soy milk, stirring continuously to prevent curdling. Allow it to come to a simmer.
Gradually add water while stirring constantly. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer for about 20 minutes until zucchini is tender and has absorbed the flavors from the soup.
Stir in chopped basil leaves before serving. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
